title: Go inside with a guide
text: Very worth getting the ticket with a guy to go inside the lighting and the symbolism is amazing. Our guide was very professional and interesting. We enjoyed his humor and knowledge.
author: Terry_C

title: Awesome tour guide
text: Anna was an excellent guide.  She was both knowledgeable and passionate about the Basilica.  She provided a local’s perspective on Gaudí and his work around Barcelona.  She could answer any question and was never boring!
author: C2396CScolleenb

title: Worth it without the tour
text: It moves fast. Tons of great information.  Very good tour guide. Going in the early evening was good for the setting sun coming in the west windows
author: erin_h

title: A moving experience.
text: The Sagrada Familia tour was a moving experience facilitated by an excellent guide  - Andria... A genius,  I mean Gaudi... Andria certainly helped us appreciate the historical context, architectural endeavour and the spiritual inspiration. Highly recommended.
author: MOSES_C

title: best tour guide
text: very good and punctual guide was very helpful i think the name wss ana. Highly recommended for all coming to barcelona.
author: Ranjeet_s

title: Great tour!
text: Adria was very knowledgeable about Gaudí and Sagrada Família. We liked that he shared some of his personal background and how he blended history of Barcelona into his remarks.
author: Martha_C

title: Interesting and knowledgable
text: Our guide spoke very good English and explained the story behind the various statues and the stained glass. He enhanced the experience of the visit.
author: Shirley_R

title: Magnificent visit
text: A huge thank you to our guide who was excellent; he gave us lots of details, it was fascinating.
author: bonnet_c

title: Location & Guide Presentation Outstanding
text: First and foremost the vision of the architect executed is awe inspiring.  The background and details of this ongoing project are so well presented by Oriole M that at one point I was almost overwhelmed with emotion when being told the story of the architect’s last days and ending.  Thank you for the experience.  David & Samira
author: Samira_M

title: Breathtaking and very...
text: Breathtaking and very informative guide Gemma, thoroughly enjoyed her narrative and timing of tour throughout
author: Daniel_B
